art_direction: 几片毛毡拼成小屋与一座山，暖红屋顶、灰蓝山体和奶油底呈现柔软层次。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Build a tiny cabin and one mountain from flat felt cutouts. The cabin has a warm red roof, an oatmeal wall, and a single dark square window; behind it, a broad gray-blue mountain rises with an ivory snow cap. Use visible soft fiber edges and a few simple hand stitches only where the roof joins the wall. Place the compact assembly on a cream felt ground with ample space around it. Keep the layers shallow and the forms bold, avoiding a full landscape or toy diorama. No trees, animals, text, or decorative buttons. The different felt surfaces and carefully offset layers should create a quiet tactile avatar.
